newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Sales to CIS boost Kekkuti exports in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Sales to CIS boost Kekkuti exports in 1996.

text.p: Hungarian mineral water bottler and distributor Kekkuti Asvanyviz Rt said on Friday its exports rose sharply to 74 million forints in 1996 from two million in 1995.
"The company's exports rose to nearly 74 million forints from two million, - making up nine percent of the company's production," Kekkuti said in its earnings report.
"This (export) went primarily to the countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States, but setting up relations with others is also under way."
"As a result we expect further growth in exports in 1997."
Kekkuti reported a pre-tax profit of 103.5 million forints on net sales of 1.17 billion forints in 1996 against a pre-tax profit of 82.8 million on sales of 838.1 million in 1995.

The company's domestic sales grew nearly 30 percent and Kekkuti said it could have grown more if summer weather had been On the Budapest Stock Exchange Kekkuti shares closed unchanged at 1,350 forints.
